title_en: Knowledge in the Harness, Reliability in the Weights: Teacher-Free Co-Evolution of an LLM Agent
title_zh: 知识在技能中，可靠性在权重中：LLM智能体的无教师协同进化
summary_en: The paper studies whether a small open model (Gemma 4 12B) can improve policy adherence and consistency from its own deployment logs without a stronger teacher. The agent reads domain policy from on-demand skills, and in each round, the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into skills, which are validated via code checks, counterexample self-review, paired retest, and a noise-calibrated gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn tool-using conversations. On τ²-bench retail and airline domains, after two rounds, the agent improves by 12.5 and 19.5 pass^1 points and 18.4 and 22.0 pass^4 points over the starting point, and exceeds the benchmark's reference agent by 11.8 and 8.0 pass^1 points and 22.8 and 16.0 pass^4 points, closing most of the gap to three frontier models. A 2x2 ablation shows that rules rescue tasks the agent never solved and carry policy knowledge that RL alone does not.
summary_zh: 本文研究小型开源模型（Gemma 4 12B）能否仅凭自身部署日志和参考结果，在没有更强教师模型的情况下，同时提升策略遵循性和行为一致性。智能体从按需技能中读取领域策略，每轮部署系统处理新任务批次，基础模型诊断失败对话并将规则写入技能，规则需通过代码检查、反例自审、配对重测和噪声校准验证门。随后使用强化学习（GRPO）在完整多轮工具使用对话上训练LoRA适配器。在τ²-bench的零售和航空领域，经过两轮迭代，智能体相比起点分别提升12.5和19.5个pass^1点，以及18.4和22.0个pass^4点；同时超过基准参考智能体（将完整策略置于系统提示中）11.8和8.0个pass^1点，以及22.8和16.0个pass^4点，缩小了与三个前沿模型的大部分差距。2x2消融实验表明，规则能挽救智能体从未解决的任务，并携带强化学习无法单独获得的策略知识。
content_en: Small open models suit private customer-service deployments but trail frontier models in two ways: they miss what the written policy requires in a given situation, and they act inconsistently on what they know. We study whether such a model can close both gaps from its own deployment logs and their reference outcomes, without a stronger teacher model. Our starting point is a Gemma 4 12B agent that reads its domain policy from on-demand skills rather than from its system prompt. In each round, the deployed system serves a fresh batch of tasks; the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into the skills, and a rule survives only if it passes code checks, counterexample self-review, a paired retest, and a noise-calibrated validation gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn, tool-using conversations. On the retail and airline domains of $τ^2$-bench, without training or selecting on official tasks, the agent after two rounds improves on this starting point by 12.5 pass$^1$ points in retail and 19.5 in airline, and by 18.4 and 22.0 pass$^4$ points.
